author: nickyeow

english.text: In the teeth of their strong opposition, we carried out our plan.

jyutping: seoi1 jin4 bei2 keoi5 dei6 faan2 deoi3 dak1 hou2 sai1 lei6，daan6 hai6 ngo5 dei6 dou1 hai6 sat6 hang4 zo2 ngo5 dei6 go3 gai3 waak6。
text: 雖然俾佢哋反對得好犀利，但係我哋都係實行咗我哋個計劃。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Beware of pickpockets here.

jyutping: ni1 dou6 jiu3 jan1 zyu6 bei2 jan4 taat3 je5。
text: 呢度要因住俾人撻嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We painted the door green.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 dou6 mun4 jau4 zo2 zou6 luk6 sik1。
text: 我哋將道門油咗做綠色。

author: Riko

english.text: She's a stubborn girl.

jyutping: keoi5 hai6 go3 ngaang6 geng2 ge3 neoi5 zai2。
text: 佢係個硬頸嘅女仔。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I did not understand him at all.

jyutping: ngo5 jyun4 cyun4 teng1 m4 ming4 keoi5 gong2 di1 je5。
text: 我完全聽唔明佢講啲嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He likes green in a lighter shade.

jyutping: keoi5 zung1 ji3 cin2 sik1 di1 ge3 luk6 sik1。
text: 佢鍾意淺色啲嘅綠色。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I caught my son stealing from a cookie jar.

jyutping: ngo5 zuk1 dou3 ngo5 go3 zai2 hai2 go3 aang1 dou6 tau1 kuk1 kei4 sik6。
text: 我捉到我個仔喺個罌度偷曲奇食。

author: tigro1973

english.text: The wolf will change shape, but will continue to eat chicken.

jyutping: long4 wui5 bin3 joeng2，daan6 gan1 zyu6 zau6 sik6 dei6 gai1 zai2。
text: 狼會變樣，但跟住就食哋雞仔。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I take back what I said.

jyutping: ngo5 sau1 faan1 ngo5 tau4 sin1 gong2 gwo3 ge2 je5。
text: 我收返我頭先講過嘅嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm back! Oh? Have we got a guest?

jyutping: ngo5 faan1 lai4 laa3！ji2？jau5 jan4 lai4 taam3 ngo5 dei6 aa3？
text: 我返嚟喇！咦？有人嚟探我哋呀？

author: fercheung

english.text: She quit her job last month.

jyutping: keoi5 soeng5 go3 jyut6 ci4 zo2 fan6 gung1。
text: 佢上個月辭咗份工。

author: kaenif

english.text: Don't waste time.

jyutping: m4 hou2 long6 fai3 si4 gaan1。
text: 唔好浪費時間。

author: nickyeow

english.text: In the meantime, cut the bread into cubes and fry them in hot oil.

jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 si4 hau6，zoeng1 gau6 min6 baau1 cit3 nap1，baai2 lok6 jau4 dou3 zaa3。
text: 喺呢個時候，將嚿麵包切粒，擺落油到炸。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I am sure this book will be of great use to you.

jyutping: ngo5 hang2 ding6 ne1 bun2 syu1 wui5 deoi3 nei5 hou2 jau5 jung6。
text: 我肯定呢本書會對你好有用。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm going to miss Tom so much.

jyutping: ngo5 wui5 hou2 gwaa3 zyu6 aa3 Tom gaa3。
text: 我會好掛住阿Tom㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I still don't know all the details.

jyutping: ngo5 dou3 ji4 gaa1 dou1 zung6 mei6 zi1 dou3 saai3 di1 sai3 zit3。
text: 我到而家都仲未知道晒啲細節。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla went to the bathroom.

jyutping: leoi4 laai1 heoi3 zo2 ci3 so2。
text: 蕾拉去咗廁所。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla is growing up.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 coeng4 daai6 gan2。
text: 蕾拉長大緊。

author: kaenif

english.text: He did not know what to do to the end.

jyutping: keoi5 m4 zi1 heoi3 dou3 zeoi3 hau6 jing1 goi1 zou6 me1。
text: 佢唔知去到最後應該做咩。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You have a very nice room.

jyutping: nei5 gaan1 fong4 hou2 leng3 wo3。
text: 你間房好靚喎。

author: clowergen

english.text: I live in Milan.

jyutping: ngo5 zyu6 hai2 mai5 laan4。
text: 我住喺米蘭。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: The dress looks good on you.

jyutping: tiu4 kwan4 hou2 can3 nei5 aa1。
text: 條裙好襯你啊。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: What you're telling me is totally different from what I heard from him.

jyutping: nei5 gong2 bei2 ngo5 teng1 ge3 je5，tung4 keoi4 gong2 ge3 jyun4 cyun4 m4 tung4。
text: 你講畀我聽嘅嘢，同渠講嘅完全唔同。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Some of the dolls are too expensive to buy.

jyutping: jau5 di1 gung1 zai2 gwai3 dak1 zai6。
text: 有啲公仔貴得滯。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: When I started learning languages, it was hard to assimilate new words and keep a pace to study, but now, after having practiced for several years I do my routine unconsciously. You can't really finish learning a language, ever, but you can reach quite a high fluency. In my case, I learn approximately 3 or 4 languages at the same time and I don't get confused. It's all a matter of practice, accustoming and how well you get used to.

jyutping: dong1 ngo5 hoi1 ci2 hok6 jyu5 jin4 go2 zan6，hou2 naan4 tung4 faa3 san1 zi6 tung4 maai4 bou2 ci4 hok6 zaap6 ge3 bou6 fat6，daan6 hai6 ji4 gaa1，lin6 zo2 gei2 nin4 zi1 hau6，ngo5 wui5 m4 zi6 gok3 gam2 zou6 ngo5 ge3 jat6 soeng4。nei5 wing5 jyun5 dou1 m4 wui5 zan1 hai6 hok6 jyun4 jat1 zung2 jyu5 jin4，daan6 hai6 nei5 ho2 ji5 daat6 dou3 gei2 gou1 ge3 lau4 lei6 dou6。ji5 ngo5 ge3 cing4 fong3 lai4 gong2，ngo5 daai6 joek3 tung4 si4 hok6 3、4 zung2 jyu5 jin4，ngo5 m4 wui5 wan6 lyun6，ni1 go3 cyun4 bou6 dou1 hai6 lin6 zaap6、zaap6 gwaan3 tung4 maai4 nei5 zaap6 gwaan3 dak1 gei2 hou2 ge3 man6 tai4。
text: 當我開始學語言嗰陣，好難同化新字同埋保持學習嘅步伐，但係而家，練咗幾年之後，我會唔自覺噉做我嘅日常。你永遠都唔會真係學完一種語言，但係你可以達到幾高嘅流利度。以我嘅情況嚟講，我大約同時學3、4種語言，我唔會混亂，呢個全部都係練習、習慣同埋你習慣得幾好嘅問題。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Robert was a bearded, black-haired Jewish manager in the Japanese software company. He introduced me into the company. He teased me about liking to eat colourful ice cream parfaits there in Tokyo. We together liked to hike the eerie, but fascinating alleyways there. Unfortunately, he cut his job term short because he had to go back to Washington State to marry his Chinese girlfriend. I attended his wedding in Seattle. I was a bit late because I mis-estimated the time to get there driving from the BC border. Robert bought a brand-new house.

jyutping: lo4 baak3 dak6 hai6 jat6 bun2 jyun5 gin2 gung1 si1 ge3 jat1 go3 wu4 sou1 hak1 faat3 ge3 jau4 taai3 ging1 lei5。 keoi5 gaai3 siu6 ngo5 jap6 gung1 si1。keoi5 naau6 ngo5 zung1 ji3 hai2 dung1 ging1 go2 dou6 sik6 ng5 ngaan4 luk6 sik1 ge3 syut3 gou1 baa1 fei2。ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 zung1 ji3 haang4 go2 dou6 ge3 gwaai3 ji6，daan6 hai6 jau6 mai4 jan4 ge3 hong6 dou6。ho2 sik1 keoi5 jan1 wai6 jiu3 faan2 waa4 sing6 deon6 zau1 tung4 keoi5 ge3 zung1 gwok3 neoi5 jau5 git3 fan1 ji4 suk1 dyun2 zo2 keoi5 ge3 gung1 zok3 kei4。ngo5 hai2 sai1 ngaa5 tou4 caam1 gaa1 zo2 keoi5 ge3 fan1 lai5。ngo5 jau5 di1 ci4 zo2，jan1 wai6 ngo5 gu2 co3 zo2 jau4 BC bin1 ging2 hoi1 ce1 heoi3 dou3 go2 dou6 ge3 si4 gaan3。lo4 baak3 dak6 maai5 zo2 gaan1 cyun4 san1 ge3 uk1。
text: 羅伯特係日本軟件公司嘅一個鬍鬚黑髮嘅猶太經理。 佢介紹我入公司。佢鬧我鍾意喺東京嗰度食五顏六色嘅雪糕芭菲。我哋一齊鍾意行嗰度嘅怪異，但係又迷人嘅巷道。可惜佢因為要返華盛頓州同佢嘅中國女友結婚而縮短咗佢嘅工作期。我喺西雅圖參加咗佢嘅婚禮。我有啲遲咗，因為我估錯咗由 BC 邊境開車去到嗰度嘅時間。羅伯特買咗間全新嘅屋。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the first time that I read about "mixed martial arts" in the Ultimate Fighting Championship, UFC. Today, the 12th of February of 2022, at the pizzeria's television screen was showing UFC, with muscled men competing. I know that some of my friends from university liked watching these kinds of shows. It's clearer to me now what the vision is.

jyutping: ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 hai2 zung1 gik6 gaak3 dau3 gam2 biu1 coi3， UFC jap6 min6 tai2 dou3 jau5 gwaan1「wan6 hap6 mou5 seot6」ge3 je5。gam1 jat6，2022 nin4 2 jyut6 12 hou6，hai2 pei1 saat3 dim3 ge3 din6 si6 waa2 min2 dou6 bo3 gan2 UFC ，jau5 gei1 juk6 naam4 bei2 coi3。ngo5 zi1 dou3 ngo5 di1 daai6 hok6 ge3 pang4 jau5 dou1 zung1 ji3 tai2 ni1 di1 zit3 muk6。ngo5 ji4 gaa1 ming4 baak6 zo2 go3 jyun6 ging2 hai6 dim2。
text: 呢個係我第一次喺終極格鬥錦標賽， UFC 入面睇到有關「混合武術」嘅嘢。今日，2022年2月12號，喺披薩店嘅電視畫面度播緊 UFC ，有肌肉男比賽。我知道我啲大學嘅朋友都鍾意睇呢啲節目。我而家明白咗個願景係點。
